subject: Re: NAM kickoff — library status + TF version risk
body:
Hi both,

Status:

- Library alpha shipped 03-27. Two internal teams are already importing it for prototyping.
- Benchmark reproduction: on the public datasets from gs://nam_datasets we match the paper's reported AUCs within 0.005 on 8 of 9 sets; the credit dataset needed the ExU feature-net variant to close the gap. Shape-function plots are in the library as a first-class API — that's the feature customers actually screenshot into their model-risk docs.
- Jorge's sweep harness is done and dress-rehearsed at 1/50th scale on titan.

Risk: the release code targets tensorflow>=1.15 via tf.compat.v1 in places, and our serving stack is TF2-only. The tf.keras.Model path is clean but the graph-mode helpers aren't. Recommendation: library v1 supports the tf.keras path only, and we document the compat helpers as unsupported. Affects one prospective customer whose pipeline is graph-mode; Oyin is checking whether they can move.

MIMIC-II DUA still with Legal.

Wanjiru
